question: What rating will MasterChef Celebrity (Telefe) record for its Thursday, November 26, 2026 broadcast?

calls.reasoning: Thursday program-level marks: 11.6 (Oct 8), 12.5 (Oct 29), 13.1 (Nov 5), 12.6 (Nov 12); all weeknight marks since mid-Oct within 11.4-13.4. Trend flat. Median ~12.4. Two-sided risks: approaching final stages and slot dominance (up) vs fatigue, Wanda Nara controversy, scheduling shifts (down). A conflicting Rio Negro report (8.9 start, 10.8 peak on Nov 12) argues for a fatter low tail. Small escape mass below for late-start/abbreviated airing.
